title: Doesn't Work
text:
Doesn't Work. My review title says it all:
Doesn't Work.
Just flat out doesn't do anything at all when I plug it into the lighter and turn it on.
Doesn't matter if car is on or off.
Cigarette Lighter works fine.
Checked fuse in vacuum and it's fine and in place.
Only one off and on switch.
Basically I got a paperweight shaped like a vacuum.
Going to toss this in my scrap pile and go with an established brand.
